You are reviewing a merged pull request. Its description:

fix(OMN-16386): OCC self-bind guard must verify the cited receipt binds THIS PR (#2125)

The occ_companion_emitter idempotency guard treated presence of a
resolvable Evidence-Source: OCC#<n> line as sufficient proof of a genuine
binding. A cascade-template PR (e.g. a release/dependency-bump PR opened
from a template whose body is copied verbatim across sibling PRs) inherits
the template's Evidence-Source line, which cites a real OCC companion --
just one minted for a DIFFERENT product PR. The presence-only check no-op'd
on that inherited citation, so the cascade PR never authored its own
occ-self-bind-pr-<n> receipt and was permanently stranded at the Receipt
Gate with pr_ticket_mismatch (live: onex_change_control#6850, #6823, #6636).

Add OccCompanionEmitter._occ_binding_matches_this_pr: verifies the cited
OCC PR's own branch was actually minted for THIS (repo, pr_number) via the
determ
